# High-risk paths. A PR touching any of these needs Mika's `human-reviewed` label.
#
# Read by .github/scripts/risk_tier.py at the PR's BASE commit, so a PR can't loosen
# the list it is judged by. Patterns use fnmatch: `*` also crosses `/`, and matching is
# case-sensitive, hence the [Cc] classes on agent-instruction files.
#
# A file on this list is high even if it also matches .github/low-risk.txt.
# A file on neither list is high too. See low-risk.txt.

# --- CI, deploy, build, and this gate --------------------------------------------------
# Deploy workflows hold LWTV_SSH_KEY; build scripts run in them.
.github/*
.githooks/*
_build_scripts/*

# --- Runs on the server -----------------------------------------------------------------
# production.yaml chmods these +x and the system cron runs them.
cron/*
*.sh
# Every deploy runs `wp acf json sync`, which rewrites live field groups.
plugins/lwtv-plugin/acf-json/*

# --- Dependency manifests and toolchain -------------------------------------------------
# composer.json/package.json and the lockfiles are NOT here: they're on the allowlist,
# and risk_tier.py itself flags anything beyond a version bump or any new package.
.npmrc
*/.npmrc
.nvmrc

# --- Bootstrap and entry points ---------------------------------------------------------
functions.php
plugins/lwtv-plugin/functions.php
plugins/lwtv-plugin/php/class-plugin.php
plugins/shadow-taxonomy/index.php
plugins/shadow-taxonomy/includes/*

# --- Public endpoints, CLI, scheduled jobs, admin/capabilities ---------------------------
plugins/lwtv-plugin/php/rest-api/*
plugins/lwtv-plugin/php/wp-cli/*
plugins/lwtv-plugin/php/schedulers/*
plugins/lwtv-plugin/php/admin-menu/*
plugins/lwtv-plugin/php/postiz/*

# --- Lint and test configuration --------------------------------------------------------
# Loosening a rule shouldn't pass quietly.
phpcs.xml*
phpunit.xml*
phpstan.neon*
phpstan-baseline.neon
eslint.config.*
.eslintrc*
*/.eslintrc*
.stylelintrc*
.stylelintignore
tests/bootstrap.php

# --- Agent instructions -----------------------------------------------------------------
# An agent PR that edits its own rules is exactly what this gate is for.
.claude/*
*/.claude/*
.gemini/*
*/.gemini/*
.superpowers/*
*[Cc][Ll][Aa][Uu][Dd][Ee]*.[Mm][Dd]
*[Aa][Gg][Ee][Nn][Tt][Ss].[Mm][Dd]
*[Gg][Ee][Mm][Ii][Nn][Ii].[Mm][Dd]

# --- Secrets and server config ----------------------------------------------------------
.env*
*/.env*
*wp-config*
*.htaccess
.gitignore
*/.gitignore
.gitattributes
*/.gitattributes
.gitmodules
.gitleaks.toml
.gitleaksignore

# --- SVG can carry script and is served from the theme directory ------------------------
*.svg
